texts.zh:
我们登上[Root.GetName]的船员报告了[From.GetName]的船只残骸似乎是一场意料之外的恒星磁风暴的杰作。由于生命支持系统彻底下线，以及因为损伤无法行动，补给船只能无助地漂流直到进入[From.GetName]的重力井。没有人幸存下来。

船只的货舱确实有数额可观的矿物——但是，[Root.GetName]的舰长谨慎的表明这是[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]的舰船设计。

这些矿物很可能属于[wreckage_owner.GetName]，如果我们认领了他们的载货，他们很可能不悦。
texts.en:
Our crew aboard the [Root.GetName] report that the [From.GetName] shipwreck appears to have been the result of an unexpected geomagnetic solar storm. The supply ship suffered a complete loss of life-support systems and sustained inoperable damage, drifting until it entered [From.GetName]'s gravity well. There are no survivors.

The ship's cargo-hold does indeed contain a notable amount of minerals - however, the captain of the [Root.GetName] cautions that the construction indicates [wreckage_owner.GetAdj] design.

It is highly likely that the minerals belong to the [wreckage_owner.GetName], and they may be displeased should we lay claim to their shipment.

船只的货舱确实有数额可观的矿物。
texts.en:
Our crew aboard the [Root.GetName] report that the [From.GetName] shipwreck appears to have been the result of an unexpected geomagnetic solar storm. The supply ship suffered a complete loss of life-support systems and sustained inoperable damage, drifting until it entered [From.GetName]'s gravity well. There are no survivors.

The ship's cargo-hold does indeed contain a notable amount of minerals.

label.zh: 我们还是不要与他们发生冲突为好。
label.en: We will not risk an altercation.

tooltips.zh:
将船上的矿物归还给[wreckage_owner.GetName]。
此举会让对方十分满意并让我们获得£influence£ 影响力。
tooltips.en:
Return the minerals to the [wreckage_owner.GetName].
This will please them and increase our £influence£ Influence.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们发现前往[wreckage_owner.Capital.GetName]的一艘失踪的[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]补给船由于受损严重而漂流至[Root.GetAdj]空间之内，然后那艘船上的货物就被你们偷走了。

你们真的以为我们不会发现吗？[wreckage_owner.GetName]强烈要求你们立刻将我们船上的物资归还给我们。
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It has come to our attention that a missing [wreckage_owner.GetAdj] supply ship sustained terminal damage en route to [wreckage_owner.Capital.GetName] and drifted into [Root.GetAdj] space, where it was promptly and unceremoniously pilfered of its cargo.

Did you really believe this transgression would go unnoticed? The [wreckage_owner.GetName] requests the immediate reimbursement of our supplies.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们发现有一艘前往[wreckage_owner.Capital.GetName]的[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]补给船失踪了。我们的探测器报告说那艘船进入了[From.From.GetName]星系，你们的人在那里将船上的货物偷走并挪为己用了。

我们无法接受你们的这种行为，请立刻归还我们的货物，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It has come to our attention that a missing [wreckage_owner.GetAdj] supply ship sustained terminal damage on its path to [wreckage_owner.Capital.GetName]. Our sensors report our vessel entered the [From.From.GetName] system, where your kind emptied its cargo for your own uses.

Unacceptable. Return our cargo at once, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

label.zh: 我们会归还你们的物资。

title.zh: 舰船残骸上的货物已归还

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们收到了关于我们补给船所运载的货物的消息，我们万分感谢你们在没有[wreckage_owner.GetAdj]介入的情况下花费时间回收了这些货物。
texts.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We have received word of our downed supply ship's cargo. We would like to extend our gratitude to you for taking the time to recover it, without the need for [wreckage_owner.GetAdj] intervention.

summary.text:
# 补给船残骸 / Supply Ship Wreckage

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:2-28; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:15 (distar.1); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:99 (distar.2); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:175 (distar.3)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。任意天体都可能生成（2级，权重1），条件是本帝国不是杀戮型，且有一个可通讯、非敌对、非杀戮型的AI普通邻国。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on any body (level 2, weight 1) if the empire is not homicidal and has a non-homicidal AI default neighbour it has communications with and is not at war with.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.1“残骸身份确认”：补给船遭遇地磁太阳风暴而失事，货舱里有矿物，且很可能属于某个邻国。
- 拿走矿物（+300矿物、获得情报）：若有失主，180天后 distar.2 对方要求赔偿——装傻（关系变差）、归还300矿物，或付不起。
- 不冒险冲突：60天后 distar.3 对方致谢（影响力、人情、好感）。

distar.1 "Wreckage Identified": a supply ship lost to a geomagnetic storm; its hold has minerals that probably belong to a neighbour.
- Take them (+300 minerals, intel): if there is an owner, 180 days later distar.2 demands repayment — play dumb (opinion penalty), return 300 minerals, or cannot afford it.
- Avoid an altercation: distar.3 60 days later, they thank us (influence, a favour, opinion).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

distar.1 两选项通向互斥的 distar.2 / distar.3；distar.2 的选项由矿物储量决定。

distar.1's options lead to the exclusive distar.2 / distar.3; distar.2's options depend on the mineral stockpile.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

distar.2 有机械智能正文。原版 distar.1 的“无接触”正文与“有接触”使用相同触发条件（都要求失主存在），实际只会显示第一段。

distar.2 has a machine text. In the original, distar.1's "nocontact" text uses the same trigger as the "contact" text (both require an owner), so effectively only the first shows.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常与 distar.1–3。树结构正确。

Checked the anomaly and distar.1–3. Tree correct.
